scripts.start: rm -rf build; mkdir -p build/static && cp web/config.json build/config.json && web-listener -c build/config.json --dir web/static --no-cache --exec 'rollup --config rollup.config.mjs --watch'
scripts.build: rm -rf build; mkdir -p build && cp -R web/static web/config.json build && rollup --config rollup.config.mjs && cd build && zip -8Xr -n .png - * > ../web-bundle.zip
